messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2 cluster c-42. p99 -> 1.9s (baseline ~250ms)

maria: seeing it, starting profiler dump and flamegraph

sam: quick heads-up — kernel selector TTL rolled at 02:14 UTC in last deploy

jordan: noisy tenant identified: tenant_abc spiking QPS on small seqs, looks like noisy neighbor

maria: profiler snippet:
```
perf: kernel_select_time_ms: 320
kvcache.hits: 12%
batch_wait_ms: 25
```

irina: can we throttle tenant_abc? we have runtime.rate_limit.tenant_abc; i'd cap to 20 rps as temp

jordan: kernel selector is choosing large-kernel path for short seqs due to percentile heuristic -> high init cost
selector rule snippet: `if seq_len_p50 < 32 then small-kernel else large-kernel`

sam: i can flip override flag: `runtime.selector.override.shortseq=1` to prefer small-kernel for <64 for 5m

irina: i'll apply tenant throttle + route 30% traffic to lm-q4f fallback. deploy-bot, canary please

deploy-bot: rollout started: feature flag runtime.selector.override.shortseq=1 -> canary 10%

maria: after 2m, kvcache hit-rate up to 46%, p95 down to 420ms

incident-bot: incident IR-2026-132 created (sev=high). owners: eng-runtime; link: https://incidents.redwood/IR-2026-132

jordan: plan: keep override 15m, tune batching window to 8ms, PR for selector heuristics (sam)

sam: noted. telemetry query used: https://console.redwood/p/metrics/incident/2187654321

maria: will stash repro + flamegraphs in gist and assign follow-up

irina: alerts are beginning to clear; p99 ~ 310ms. schedule rollback of emergency throttle in 5m if stable :thumbsup:

jordan: great response team, postmortem tbd. :raised_hands:
